speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided any patient response yet, but I understand your symptoms are fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any pain in your right upper quadrant of your abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age and unintentional weight loss, have you noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, or any dark urine? Also, have you experienced fever, chills, or a change in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests (LFTs), Complete Blood Count (CBC), and Alkaline Phosphatase. Have you noticed any itching, abdominal swelling, or changes in your urine and stool color?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver Function Tests: AST Elevated, ALT Elevated, ALP Significantly elevated, Bilirubin Elevated; Complete Blood Count: WBC Normal, Hemoglobin Normal, Platelets Normal; Additional Imaging Findings: Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder with no stones; Urine Analysis: Amber colored with positive Bilirubin. Clinical observation notes icteric skin and sclera, and an enlarged gallbladder without tenderness during abdominal palpation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mirizzi Syndrome (or gallbladder carcinoma causing obstruction without stones visible on ultrasound).

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound and CT Scan of the abdomen to evaluate the cystic duct and common bile duct for extrinsic compression or tumor infiltration.
